finding.title: Started parent with failed evidence write can be mislabeled not-run
finding.trigger: The original parent may have run or still have unsettled output when execute writes stdout/stderr, or after execute returns before result.json/report append. An OSError at these writes reaches main catch before report.cases append. Finally pads all remaining expected cases as not-run.
finding.impact: passed remains false, so this does not fabricate successful execution. However notRunCount may include a launched or unknown parent and therefore misstate observed execution coverage.
finding.basis: Static control-flow construction, not a reproduced Windows or storage failure. Synthetic reader control preserves a prepared empty parent directory with a padded not-run entry as incomplete.
finding.minimalRepairSuggestion: Track the exact current parent after directory preparation and before execute. On exception, retain an explicit failed-or-incomplete entry for that current attempt, preserving known PID/terminal/evidence error if available. Only parents never prepared/launched should be padded not-run. Do not infer settlement from receipt writing failure or kill a process tree.
finding.readerMitigation: Only absent original per-parent directory plus exact bound not-run aggregate entry becomes not_run. Existing empty/partial evidence directory remains incomplete_or_unverified.
